● User Guide

Everything GasOne does, in one place.

A complete walkthrough of every screen and setting in GasOne — daily collection entry, store stock register, reports, product rates, and admin configuration. Written in plain English for anyone using the app for the first time. Every screen below is shown as a labeled diagram with a numbered explanation for each button.

Admin User Delivery Boy Store Keeper Super Admin
01

Getting Started & Roles

Every screen in GasOne is gated by role. Knowing which role you're using explains why a menu, button, or column might look different from a colleague's screen.

  • 1
    App logo & nameJust branding — confirms you're on the right app.
  • 2
    Mobile Number fieldType the mobile number your Admin registered for you.
  • 3
    Password fieldTap the small eye icon inside it to reveal what you typed.
  • 4
    Login buttonTap after filling both fields. You'll land on the first screen your role allows.
🔐
Biometric login After your first password login on a device, you can turn on fingerprint/face unlock from the sidebar's fingerprint icon, so future logins skip typing the password.

The five roles

RoleWhat they see
AdminEverything for their own agency — Dashboard, Denomination, Store Entry, Reports, User Management, Products & Rates, Settings, Permissions. The only role that can enter Expenses, edit Products/Rates, and unlock a Store Keeper's locked day.
UserA restricted view of the same agency — which menus they can see is controlled by Admin on the Permissions screen. Cannot see cash amounts if Admin has hidden them.
Delivery BoyConfined to one screen: their own Denomination entry, always as themselves. A saved entry stays editable while it is Pending, if the Admin allows that for the delivery boy; once approved or rejected it is locked.
Store KeeperConfined to one screen: today's Store Entry register. Locked after the first save, same one-time-unlock pattern.
Super AdminCross-agency — manages every Company account, not day-to-day operations for any single agency.
02

Dashboard

AdminUser

The first thing Admin and User see after login — a live snapshot of the day, plus anything that needs attention right now.

  • 1
    Period selectorSwitches every card below between Today / This Week / This Month / This Year — nothing else needs re-opening.
  • 2
    Store Keeper warning bannerOnly appears when today's Store Entry hasn't been saved yet — a nudge for Admin to follow up.
  • 3
    Summary cardsCollection, Gas Value, Cylinder Count, Transactions, Active Delivery Boys, Expense, and Net Total — see the table below for what each means.
  • 4
    Today's Net TotalCollection + Expense combined — the real bottom line after costs.
CardWhat it shows
CollectionTotal cash collected across every denomination entry in the period.
Gas ValueCylinder quantity × current rate, summed — what the collection should add up to.
Gas Cylinder CountTotal cylinders delivered.
TransactionsNumber of denomination entries saved.
Active Delivery BoysDelivery boys with at least one entry.
ExpenseNet of every Admin-entered expense — red if negative, green if positive.
Net TotalCollection + Expense — the actual bottom line.
03

Denomination Entry

Admin User Delivery Boy

The daily heart of GasOne — recording how many cylinders each delivery boy delivered and the cash collected for it, broken down by note/coin.

  • 1
    Full screen & RefreshFull screen (⛶, web only) hides the sidebar so the grid gets the whole width. Refresh (⟳) reloads the grid from the server, discarding unsaved changes.
  • 2
    Select DateDefaults to today. Admin/User can pick any date; Delivery Boy is always on today.
  • 3
    Delivery Boy pickerSearch and pick who this row belongs to — every quantity cell in the row stays locked until this is chosen.
  • 4
    Cylinder-size columnsOne column per configured size — how many of that size this delivery boy delivered.
  • 5
    Denomination columnsOne column per note/coin (₹500 down to ₹1) — how many of each were collected.
  • 6
    Grand Total & Gas ValueGrand Total is the cash total for the row; Gas Value is what it should be worth. They turn green when they match, red when they don't.
  • 7
    + Add RowAdds a new blank row to enter another delivery boy's collection for this date.
  • 8
    Notes, Expense & SaveThe two round icons open Notes and Expense (Expense is Admin-only); Save commits every filled-in row.
✅
Reading the match colors Cylinder value is compared against cash collected, rounded to the nearest rupee — the same rounding shown on screen. A logged Expense (see below) is netted in before this check, so a real cost never falsely turns it red.

Full screen mode (web only)

The ⛶ icon hides the sidebar entirely so the grid can use the full browser width — tap it again to bring the sidebar back.

04

Notes

Admin User Delivery Boy

A free-form log for customer details that don't fit the denomination grid — open it from the notes icon on the Denomination screen's bottom bar.

  1. Open Notes from the Denomination screen's bottom bar (before the Expense icon).
  2. Fill in any row — Customer ID, Customer Name, Gas Qty, and a free Remarks field. Nothing here is calculated; it's a plain log.
  3. Need more than ten lines? Tap + Add Line for another blank row.
  4. Save once — a single Save button commits every filled-in row together, new and edited alike.
💡
Notes never affect the match indicator or Grand Total — it's purely a record of who was visited and what was noted for them.
05

Expense

Admin only

Real costs paid out of a day's collection — vehicle fuel, repairs, anything that reduces (or occasionally adds to) what's actually in hand.

  1. Open Expense (Admin only) from the Denomination screen's bottom bar.
  2. Enter a description and amount.Negative (e.g. -200) reduces the day's total; positive adds to it.
  3. Watch the total update as you type — no need to save first to see the running net.
  4. Save once for every filled-in line, same single-button pattern as Notes.
✅
How it affects the day The Grand Total becomes Collected − Expense, shown with a small breakdown line underneath. The match check still compares against the raw collected cash — a real, explained expense never turns it red.

Expense totals also appear on the Dashboard and in Reports, grouped by date.

06

Store Entry

Admin Store Keeper

The cylinder stock register — full/empty counts by section, one sheet per day. Store Keeper fills in their own day; Admin can review or enter any date.

  • 1
    Export & History iconsExport/Print the current sheet, or search past entries by date. Row labels are renamed by the Super Admin (DGS Row Labels).
  • 2
    Date navigationPrevious/next-day arrows plus the date itself (tap to open a calendar) — Admin only, Store Keeper is locked to today.
  • 3
    Sl.No / Created ByFilled in automatically once the sheet is saved for the first time.
  • 4
    Invoice numbersOptional reference numbers for this day's sheet.
  • 5
    Section cardsOne card per cylinder-size section, each with Full/Empty columns for every stock-movement row (opening stock, received, sold, returned, closing stock, etc).

Store Keeper's flow

  1. Open Store Entry — always today, nothing else reachable from this login.
  2. Fill in Full/Empty counts for each row across every section.
  3. Save.A confirmation dialog warns this locks the sheet — every field goes read-only after.
🔒
Locked after save Store Keeper cannot edit that day again unless Admin grants a one-time re-edit. Saving again after using that unlock re-locks it immediately.

Admin's flow

Admin can move to any date using the arrows/calendar and is never blocked by the lock — Admin's Save always goes through directly.

Reports

AdminUser

Every saved denomination entry, filterable by date range and delivery boy, with totals and export options.

  • 1
    Filter barDate range (Admin only — User is locked to today), Delivery Boy, Entered By, and Status (Approved / Pending / Rejected / All).
  • 2
    Export rowExport or Share as PDF/Excel, or Print directly — carries the same figures and expense breakdown shown on screen.
  • 3
    Results tableEvery entry matching the filters above, with summary stat cards (Total Entries, Gas Cylinder Count, Total Amount, and for Admin, Expenses / Net Total) shown above it.

User Management

Admin

Manage everyone with a login, filtered by role, from one screen.

  • 1
    SearchFind anyone by name, mobile number, or role.
  • 2
    Role filter chipsNarrow the list to just Admin, User, Store Keeper, or Delivery Boy accounts.
  • 3
    Each account rowName, mobile number, role badge, an active/inactive indicator, and a delete icon.

The round + button (bottom-right) creates a new account. A delivery boy doesn't need a login to appear in Denomination Entry's worker picker — creating one here is only needed if they'll use the app directly.

09

Products & Rate Management

Admin

Defines every cylinder size sold and its current rate — this powers the Gas Value column everywhere else in the app. Open it from Settings → Cylinder Products.

  • 1
    Category header + add (➕)Products are grouped (e.g. Domestic, Non Domestic); tap ➕ to add a new size to that group.
  • 2
    Each product rowName, category, size, and current rate. ⏱ shows its rate history, 🗑 deletes it, the toggle switches it active/inactive, and ≡ lets you drag to reorder — this order is what shows up as columns in Denomination Entry.
  • 3
    Another categoryEach category is listed with its own count and products — a size like "10Kg" can exist in more than one category with different rates.
💡
Denomination Entry always uses the current rate for anything not yet saved. Only Reports and saved history show the rate that was actually locked in at save time — that's what the rate history (⏱) is for.

A greyed-out toggle (like "10Kg" above) means that size is switched off — it won't show up as a column for new entries, but its past data isn't deleted.

Settings

Admin

Agency-wide toggles that shape how the whole app behaves for everyone at your company.

  • 1
    Dark themeSwitches the whole app's color scheme for this device.
  • 2
    LanguageEnglish or Tamil, applied app-wide immediately.
  • 3
    Cylinder Product ManagementOpens the Products & Rates screen.
  • 4
    Delivery Boy LimitCaps how many delivery boy accounts this agency can have. The Super Admin sets it, and it stays locked for the Admin unless the Super Admin allows editing.
Company policies (set by the Super Admin)Effect
Hide amount columnsRemoves cash/denomination and Gas Value columns app-wide for non-Admin roles — for agencies that want counts-only entry.
Max amount digitsCaps how many digits can be typed into a single amount cell.
Daily line limit policyWhether Admin can cap how many rows a delivery boy saves per day.
Export options policyWhether Export/Share/Print buttons appear on Reports at all.
Transaction delete policyWhether Admin can delete an already-saved denomination row outright.
11

Permissions

Admin

Controls which menu items a User-role account can see in the sidebar — Admin's own menu is never restricted here.

Toggle off Dashboard, Delivery Boy Master, Denomination or Reports to hide it for every User-role login at this agency. Store Entry, User Management, Settings and Permissions are Admin-only anyway. Delivery Boy and Store Keeper are unaffected — their confined single-screen access isn't controlled from here.

12

Tips & Troubleshooting

"Collection Mismatch" won't go green

Check that a delivery boy is actually selected for every row with numbers in it — quantity cells only count once a worker is chosen. If an expense explains the gap, log it under Expense rather than adjusting the cash entry to force a match.

A delivery boy can't edit their saved row

Expected once the Admin has approved or rejected the entry, or when editing while Pending is switched off for that delivery boy (the Allow edit while pending option in Delivery Boy Master).

Store Keeper's register is locked

Same pattern — Admin unlocks it for one more edit from the Store Entry Admin view for that date.

A screen or button is missing

Check Permissions — Admin may have hidden that menu for the User role, or Settings may have amount columns hidden agency-wide.
